import subprocess

UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"

# Mark task 10 as completed
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "10", "completed"], check=True)

# Mark task 11 as active
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "11", "active"], check=True)

print("Task 10 set to COMPLETED. Task 11 set to ACTIVE.")
